description: A static call gives an expanded final argument that isn't a list or tuple
notes: The spec says a static call returns the argument expressions, but not what becomes of the ... after the final one, which changes how the arguments map to parameters, and evaluating this call would fail because the expanded argument must be a list or tuple. hashicorp/hcl's hcl.StaticCall has no field for it, and FunctionCallExpr.ExprCall (hclsyntax/expression.go) gives the final argument like the others.
